=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3055) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Command-scoped `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed and `GH_TOKEN` is embedded in clone URLs.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments and Git diagnostics and persist in temporary `.git/config`, violating the repository authentication contract and failing the Git-auth hygiene tests.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (line 585) and memory_ensure_branch (lines 151 and 180) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, networked memory operations use unauthenticated bare `git`, and force-tick URLs embed `GH_TOKEN`.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, memory branch and force-tick operations fail authentication or leak credentials through argv, diagnostics, and persisted Git configuration.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase bypasses the model-provider broker and runs Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while workflow credentials remain available.
  WHY: Issue- or log-derived diagnostic content can cause the model to read, mutate, or exfiltrate workspace and credential data outside the previous brokered read-only boundary.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247) and emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and per-path limits were removed, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, or `.aws` to be read into model context.
  WHY: Credential-bearing files can be exposed to the model, and the removed path and byte caps eliminate the prior input-safety boundary.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:REST transform at line 769 and GraphQL transforms at lines 833-839 and 912-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comments retain only `{author, body, created_at}` and drop `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer authentication and approval authorization cannot validate comments, so pending requests duplicate and terminal actions remain pending.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:file now ends at line 140 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `model_provider_broker_*` lifecycle, ACL, preparation, and execution helpers were deleted while live workflow and script callers remain.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found` before Codex starts, removing the credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:former `git_with_github_auth` after `gh_retry` and former `review_blocked_*` family | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the review-blocked approval/successor helper family were deleted while callers and tests remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes fail with `command not found`, and review-blocked approval, refusal, successor, and consumed-marker flows break.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:usage line 7 and option parser lines 30-66 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and its associated process-group metadata handling were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated review editors exit with `unknown option` before launching, and the removed supervision prevents survivor verification.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:_kill_child_group_if_running (lines 290-303) and _signal_child_group (lines 334-347) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user identity capture, privileged signaling, and survivor verification were replaced by simplified direct signaling.
  WHY: `nobody`-owned editor descendants can survive wrapper termination, leaving stalled isolated processes orphaned.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:option loop at lines 99-112 and hardcoded base_url at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and the provider URL is hard-coded while callers still pass the loopback broker URL.
  WHY: Brokered config generation exits with `unknown argument` before writing configuration, and paths that bypass the option can use the public provider endpoint instead of the credential boundary.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:staged-support restore block (lines 101-237) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block is gated on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` or `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow exports either variable.
  WHY: The block is dead and self-repo implement runs can overwrite branch-owned helpers with `SCRIPT_REF` copies.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:lines 13-71 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support escalation branch requires `SSB_REASON` and `SSB_FILES`, but no producer sets or propagates them.
  WHY: Rebase conflicts do not reach the `ai:needs-human` latch, GitHub comment, or Telegram alert.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Headers, markers, summaries, and path counts are no longer charged against `used_bytes`, and `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can produce output substantially beyond the documented `max_bytes` context limit.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 30 and 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError` before the targeted-file-context tests execute.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:Configure git auth for memory helper clones at lines 68-81 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`, `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0`, and `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0` are exported only within one workflow step.
  WHY: Later helper-fetch and memory-operation steps do not inherit the authentication configuration.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-187) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Branch existence probing and branch creation/push are separate operations rather than an atomic or race-safe initialization.
  WHY: Concurrent first runs can both observe a missing branch and one can lose the initialization push.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:lines 3040-3052 and 3081-3083 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_resolve_origin_url` can retain a tokenized origin URL after the process's `GH_TOKEN` has rotated.
  WHY: Later memory operations use a stale revoked credential and still expose it in subprocess arguments.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:lines 101 and 113 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config` rewrites `${HOME}/.codex/config.toml` without locking.
  WHY: Concurrent diagnose or Codex writers can interleave writes and leave an unparsable TOML configuration.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:git merge-file invocation lines 203-204 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` arguments are reported as applying HEAD changes to the editor version instead of rebasing editor changes onto HEAD.
  WHY: With overlapping edits, the reported ordering can silently drop branch changes; minimax_minimax-m3 and moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly reject this finding and state that the order is correct.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
